_comment: Offline fallback questions, used when Gemini is unavailable. Every question is scenario-based - no definition questions, matching the same rule the LLM prompt enforces. expectedPoints double as the rubric for the heuristic scorer, so they must be concrete keywords a real answer would contain. Each pool holds 10 questions - 4 EASY, 4 MEDIUM, 2 HARD - which is what lets FallbackLlmClient fill the largest allowed interview (10 questions) from any experience band without ever repeating one. Entries are ordered easiest first within a pool.
